feat(hosting): platform bring-up — docker01/02, deploy wrapper, tenant pipeline

Terraform: docker02 staging VM; docker01 cloud-init snippet moved out of
terraform state (bpg provider read-back bug on dir datastores) and
shipped via ops/hosting/deploy-cloudinit.sh with YAML-lint gating.

Ansible: 14 bring-up defects fixed — handler-order race + controller-side
lookups masquerading as guest state (dockremap), group_vars/host_vars
relocated under inventory/ (cwd resolution invisible to plays), duplicate
YAML key silently carving /22 IPv6 pools, daemon.json max-file type,
ext4 quota-feature mount breaker stripped (feature unusable on this
kernel; runbook'd), nftables per-table flush (flush ruleset wiped Docker
NAT), Caddy repo URL that never existed + log-dir ownership race,
userns-remap exporter conversions, backup init-on-first-use + restart
guarantee + honest offsite marker + whole-tenant-tree snapshots.

Ops: deploy.sh — one command, one key, build -> snippets -> terraform ->
guest-agent IP resolution -> bootstrap, ending in a per-host verify phase
that blocks tenant onboarding on failure. Restore drill proven: backup
now covers the whole tenant tree (compose + .env + data), restore
verified 1293 files / compose + env PRESENT.

CI: scripts/hosting-ci.sh + check-image-pins.py — static gates for every
defect class (yaml dup keys, jinja parse, snippet validity + both-keys,
data-uid under userns, registry-truth of every image pin) plus a
baseline-gated gitleaks job in auto-deploy so no new secret can deploy
(repo is public; 22 historical findings baselined, rotation ledger in
REVIEW.md). Monitoring scrape targets for both guests staged.

Backup flow:
1. incus exec tar world data from inside container (no sudo needed)
2. Restic backup of tarballs with 14d/4w/2m retention
3. Clean old tarballs (keep 7 days locally)
4. Runs via systemd user timer at 03:00 daily

Tested: 612KB world backed up successfully.

Author: WyattAu
Message:
docs: add disaster recovery runbook

Comprehensive runbook covering 5 recovery scenarios with step-by-step
procedures:

1. Container crash / deploy failure — automatic rollback + manual steps
2. Application data restore — Restic point-in-time recovery (local + B2)
3. Full server recovery — 10-phase procedure from bare metal to running
   (TrueNAS install → prerequisites → age key → git clone → B2 restore
    → directories → deploy → verify → terraform state → monitoring data)
4. Compromised secrets — rotation procedures for Cloudflare, Keycloak,
   Forgejo, databases, webhook secret, and age key
5. Cloudflare tunnel failure — diagnosis and recovery

Includes prerequisite checklist (5 critical items to store offsite),
backup verification schedule (daily check + monthly restore test),
and TrueNAS-specific notes (noexec /opt, binary paths, Docker data root).
